company.tag: Builds and runs airports, highways, mining services, copper, solar and wind equipment and data centres
products: Highways and expressways built for government agencies
Coal and iron ore mining services for mine owners

company.productNote: Businesses named in Adani Enterprises' 2025–26 integrated annual report. Adani Ports, Adani Power, Adani Green Energy, Adani Energy Solutions, Adani Total Gas and AWL Agri Business were created from this company and are separate listed companies; they are not part of its results. The data centres are a joint venture. Pictures are annual-report photographs.
